description: This Java class 'LiveSignalEnforcement' enforces live commands, events, and message commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework, handling authorization, publication, and response management for signals.

classes.name: LiveSignalEnforcement
classes.description: Enforces live commands, events, and message commands, handling authorization, publication, and response management within the Ditto framework.

classes.name: LiveSignalEnforcement.Provider
classes.description: Provides instances of LiveSignalEnforcement configured with caches and pub/sub for live signal enforcement.

methods.name: enforce
methods.description: Main enforcement method that processes a signal, retrieves enforcer, and delegates enforcement based on signal type.

methods.name: doEnforce
methods.description: Performs enforcement logic for a given signal and enforcer, handling different signal types.

methods.name: enforceLiveCommandResponse
methods.description: Handles enforcement of command responses, routing responses to original requesters.

methods.name: enforceLiveSignal
methods.description: Enforces live signals based on streaming type, including messages, events, and commands.

methods.name: enforceLiveEvent
methods.description: Enforces live events, checking permissions and publishing if authorized.

methods.name: isLiveSignal
methods.description: Checks if a signal is a live signal based on streaming type.

methods.name: enforceMessageCommand
methods.description: Enforces message commands, checking authorization before publication.

methods.name: publishMessageCommand
methods.description: Publishes message commands with appropriate read permissions.

methods.name: rejectMessageCommand
methods.description: Creates an exception for unauthorized message commands.

methods.name: publishLiveSignal
methods.description: Publishes signals via pub/sub and manages response receivers.

methods.name: addToResponseReceiver
methods.description: Adds a signal to response receiver cache if response is required.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if a command is authorized for a given enforcer.

methods.name: extractMessageResourceKey
methods.description: Extracts resource key from a message command for permission checks.

methods.name: insertResponseReceiverConflictFree
methods.description: Inserts response receiver with conflict-free correlation ID.

methods.name: setUniqueCorrelationIdForGlobalDispatching
methods.description: Assigns a unique correlation ID for global dispatching, ensuring no conflicts.

methods.name: findUniqueCorrelationId
methods.description: Recursively finds a unique correlation ID not present in cache.
